name: opendexter
description: Give your agent spending power: it finds the right paid service, shows you the price, and pays from a wallet only you control.

interface.shortDescription: Give your agent spending power: it finds the right paid service, shows you the price, and pays from a wallet only you control.
interface.longDescription:
OpenDexter lets your assistant get things done that cost money. It can pull live market data, generate images, run research, and call thousands of other specialized services, paying for each one in the moment: pennies per call, no subscriptions, no API keys.

You stay in charge of every dollar. Your assistant shows the exact price and the seller before anything is paid, it spends only within rules you set, and browsing never costs a thing: searching services and checking prices are always free.

The money lives in a wallet that belongs to you, not to Dexter. You create it in about a minute with Face ID or a security key, and only your device can approve spending. Dexter never holds your keys.

When your assistant finds a service worth keeping, it can save it as a reusable skill and, if you choose, publish it to the marketplace at x402gle.com.

Under the hood it runs on x402, the open standard for paying for API calls.
